name: Fisheye-GS
definition: A method that integrates fisheye camera data into 3D Gaussian Splatting by recalculating the projection transformation for fisheye cameras and optimizing the rendering process with a reduced number of overlapped tiles to handle extreme curvature and wide field of view.
summary: Fisheye-GS adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting for fisheye lenses by using equidistant projection and optimized tile-based rendering to maintain quality and real-time performance across wide fields of view.
